disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to satisfy, pay, or discharge a bail forfeiture judgment after being on the board for more than 45 consecutive days for the same forfeiture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to satisfy, pay, or otherwise discharge a bail forfeiture judgment after the bail agent's name is on the board for more than forty-five consecutive days for the same forfeiture

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to satisfy, pay, or discharge a final, nonappealable bail forfeiture judgment within 60 days of notice of entry of judgment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to satisfy, pay, or otherwise discharge a final, nonappealable bail forfeiture judgment within sixty days following notice of entry of judgment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report, preserve, retain separately, or return collateral received as security on any bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report, to preserve without use and retain separately, or to return collateral received as security on any bond to the principal or depositor of the collateral

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay a final, nonappealable judgment for failure to return or repay collateral received to secure a bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay a final, nonappealable judgment award for failure to return or repay collateral received to secure a bond

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to execute bail bonds while on the board where the forfeiture judgment has not been paid, stayed, vacated, exonerated, or discharged.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing execution of bail bonds in any court in this State while on the board, where the bail forfeiture judgment that resulted in placement on the board has not been paid, stayed, vacated, exonerated, or otherwise discharged

disciplinary_grounds.description: Payment of commission, service fee, brokerage, or other valuable consideration to any unlicensed person for selling, soliciting, or negotiating bail.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Payment, directly or indirectly, of any commission, service fee, brokerage, or other valuable consideration to any person selling, soliciting, or negotiating bail within this State unless, at the time the services were performed, the person was duly licensed for the performance of the services

disciplinary_grounds.description: A bail agent who is also an attorney representing a person to whom the attorney has furnished bail for compensation in the same proceeding.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A bail agent who is also an attorney shall not represent a person to whom the attorney has furnished bail for compensation in any proceeding for which the attorney has furnished bail.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to meet or maintain the conditions and requirements necessary to qualify for the granting of a license.
